t: Start Your Day Kind With New KIND® Breakfast | KIND Snacks | KIND Snacks
s: March 25, 2025 - NEW YORK (September 6, 2015) – KIND Healthy Snacks(open in new tab) (KIND) today unveiled its first line of breakfast bars, KIND Breakfast. Soft-baked with a crispy outside, KIND Breakfast offers sustained energy from whole grains. As with all KIND snacks, the bars are made with whole, recognizable ingredients, including a unique blend of five super grains: gluten free oats, millet, buckwheat, amaranth, and quinoa.
